_comment: Single source of truth for the site's own absolute URL.
Almost nothing needs this: the reader resolves its own links relatively,
and runtime JavaScript uses location.origin, both of which follow whatever
domain actually served the page. The exception is Open Graph / link-preview
metadata (WhatsApp, Telegram, X), which must carry a fully-qualified URL and
is read by crawlers that never execute JavaScript — so it cannot be set at
runtime and has to be written into the HTML itself.
Change siteOrigin here, then run:  python3 tools/set_site_url.py
That rewrites every <!-- site-url: ... --> marked tag in the HTML to match.
Verify at any time with:           python3 tools/set_site_url.py --check
